title: files.confirmWritten
label: confirmWritten
description: confirmWritten({resourceId,size,sha256}); only after the authorized client has written and read back this native project artifact. Exact size and hash must match the retained generated resource.
inputContract: confirmWritten({resourceId,size,sha256}); only after the authorized client has written and read back this native project artifact. Exact size and hash must match the retained generated resource.
outputContract: status=client_write_confirmed; writeConfirmation=client_reported_verified_write. Browser cannot prove disk fsync. Only the matching document identity and revision can become saved; later edits remain dirty. This grants no filesystem access.
errorModel: Direct page file scripts throw or reject with error.code. MCP callers follow mcpCall; invoke is not an Agent method. Page-script invoke({method:"files.confirmWritten",args}) catches failures into a structured failed result. Underlying document/kernel and browser I/O errors can propagate; inspect error.code and message.

selectionGuide.chooseWhen: 核验客户端实际写入并回读的大小/hash确认，不是让页面代写磁盘。

alternatives.chooseWhen: 生成保留配方/历史/源资产的原生工程；生成资源不等于写盘。
生成指定 STEP/STL/BREP/PNG 交换产物，不保存全部原生历史。
读取现有资源字节/Blob，不重新计算或证明磁盘写入。
发起浏览器下载生成资源，只证明下载动作已启动。
通过已授权文件句柄写盘；结果仍须按合同回读核验。
把尚未过期的同一产物重新附加送达，不重算几何。
释放临时资源；不删除工程实体或已下载磁盘文件。
按当前几何创建投影、剖视和尺寸工程图定义。
导出已有drawingId工程图，或readLogo返回的logoId原轮廓DXF/JSON；不必创建三维实体或写脚本。
